notes: Short 5-page arXiv paper (pp. 4-5 mostly references). Internal inconsistency: Methods (Sec. II-B) describe a single stratified 80:20 train:test split with Optuna tuning and retraining on the full training set, but the Fig. 2 caption and Sec. III-B say each bar is the average across cross-validated folds (number of folds not given), so statistic and n_runs are not_reported. Fig. 2 bar heights are not readable from text; values come from the prose. Clause scope: '80 clauses' with no per-class/total qualifier; the printed clause indices C149 and C73 exceed 80, which hints at 80 per class x 2 classes = 160 total, but this is not stated, so kept not_reported. Number of input features, number of thermometer bins and Boolean feature count are not reported. Train/test sizes (~264/66) not stated. Class weights for a TM are mentioned without saying how they were applied in PyTsetlinMachine.
